about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography ENGINE
paragraphs: The current L460-generation Range Rover Autobiography is fitted with BMW-sourced V8 engines — a move away from the previous JLR-designed units. It uses two distinct BMW V8s: the N63 (the standard V8 tier) and the S68 (the performance/flagship tier). They're both 4.4-litre twin-turbo "hot-vee" engines, meaning the turbochargers sit in the V of the engine rather than outside it. This design has particular implications for heat management and long-term component wear — valve seals and coolant lines are the main areas we pay close attention to on both. We rebuild both to the same exacting standard.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace BMW N63 or BMW S68 engines for every Range Rover Autobiography on the road.

cards.body: A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the standard V8 Autobiography from 2022 onwards. The N63 is BMW's "hot-vee" V8 design, with a known pattern of valve seal wear and cooling system maintenance requirements over time. We replace timing chains, valve seals, and coolant components as standard on every N63 rebuild.

cards.body: A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the SV / performance-flagship Autobiography from 2022 onwards. This is a more powerful derivative of the same engine family (shared with the Defender Octa and high-performance BMW M models). It carries the same hot-vee characteristics as the N63, with the same pattern of valve seal wear and cooling system attention required over time. We replace timing chains, valve seals, and coolant components as standard on every S68 rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The L460 Autobiography uses two completely distinct BMW engine families — the N63 and the S68 — which share a basic architecture but have different power outputs, tuning, and some internal component variations. They are not interchangeable: an N63 ECU will not run an S68 correctly, and physical fitment differs in some ancillaries. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (BMW N63 or BMW S68) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
